title.en: Navi Pillay wins the Peace Prize. Can law restrain power?
title.zh: 皮莱摘诺贝尔和平奖：法律能管住强权吗？

summary.en: The Nobel Committee honours a jurist for international law; recognition is not an enforcement mechanism.
summary.zh: 诺贝尔委员会表彰国际法工作者；荣誉并非执行权。

title.en: Jensen Huang pledges $1 billion for science. What actually arrives?
title.zh: 黄仁勋许10亿美元助科学：承诺最后如何落地？

summary.en: NVIDIA announces commitments valued at $1 billion over five years, not a verified cash transfer or completed breakthroughs.
summary.zh: 英伟达宣布五年总值10亿美元的承诺，不等于现金已到账或突破已完成。
